title: feat: add stateless Responses support across text models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds direct stateless `/v1/responses` routing for built-in models with declared native endpoints.
- Adapts Chat Completions to those Responses endpoints, including tools, structured output, reasoning, streaming, and usage.
- Stores exact Responses URLs for community models and endpoint agents; managed prompt/MCP agents emit Responses JSON/SSE natively.
- Preserves delegated auth, fallbacks, attribution, billing, prompt-cache usage, and fails closed on missing or malformed successful usage.
- Supersedes #11433 and carries forward @ElliotEtag's original Responses work.

Addresses #8931

Tests: full Gen and Enter suites; post-merge TypeScript checks and focused routing, agent, billing, and streaming suites.

gist.headline: Responses, no memory required
gist.blurb: The text hive now speaks stateless Responses across its built-in models. Tools, streams, reasoning, and neatly structured JSON can all take the same direct route.
gist.summary: Added native stateless OpenAI-compatible /v1/responses routing across built-in, community, and agent-backed text models, adapting Chat Completions features including tools, structured output, reasoning, streaming, usage, billing, and prompt-cache tracking.
gist.impact: Developers can use /v1/responses with more Pollinations text models and agents while retaining delegated auth, fallbacks, attribution, accurate usage, and native JSON or SSE responses.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy API-routing garden: Polli, wearing tiny router-technician goggles, guides several labeled response packets from a retro terminal through one clear stateless pipe toward model flowers. The monitor robot eagerly watches JSON blocks, tool icons, a reasoning lightbulb, and SSE stream sparkles emerge from the pipe, while code-vines and flowers make the routing system feel alive.
